endorsements.quote: Moreover, any AI-based model developed within the OBESI–NET framework will require external validation, bias assessment, transparency, and clinical interpretability before being used in decision-support scenarios.

unlisted_practices: Implement federated learning so sensitive patient data remain stored locally at participating centers rather than being centralized for AI model training.

Accompany AI implementation with structured training for clinicians on digital data collection, data quality, privacy protection, real-world evidence, AI literacy, bias recognition, and interpretation of predictive outputs.

Include shared protocols, local implementation responsibilities, multidisciplinary coordination, continuous training, and clinician and patient feedback mechanisms in the organizational model for AI deployment.
Communicate clearly to professionals and patients about data collection, consent procedures, clinical meaning, limitations of algorithmic outputs, and the role of professional judgement.

screen.reason: The paper is a conceptual proposal and expert opinion describing a national network framework (OBESI-NET) for future AI-supported obesity monitoring and data collection, rather than an empirical evaluation of an AI tool.
